repos.name: ML-for-beginners
repos.description: A practical Machine Learning repository for students, researchers, and builders. Includes beginner-friendly guides, coding references, and Jupyter notebooks covering EDA, preprocessing, supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and deep learning. Designed to help you use ML as a practical tool in research and projects.
